name: Hammamet

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official OTC geoportal page loaded anonymously. It describes a cadastral information project and regional data management, but the current HTML exposed no interactive parcel viewer, public map/API URL, source configuration, parcel schema, CRS, or ID-plus-geometry response.
Nabeul governorate directory identifies the regional Office de la Topographie et du Cadastre Nabeul/Zaghouan and its Nabeul address/telephone. No parcel data endpoint is provided.
First-party governorate directory identifies Hammamet municipality and contact context. No cadastral service or parcel layer is provided.
National administrative portal describes cadastral plans, boundary records and the regional cadastre service process; it is procedural prose, not an anonymous parcel geometry service.

Official government search result describes remote access to a digital map of state real estate. This was not treated as a general parcel cadastre and no request for unsafe ownership or title data was made.

qualification.reason: Only official institutional/local-custodian evidence was verified. No anonymous parcel response, native identity, geometry, or CRS was obtained.

scopeLimits: One geoportal page and regional directory evidence do not establish parcel coverage in Hammamet or Tunisia.
No exact-point response, map extent test, or parcel API response was obtained; this is not evidence of absence.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or global TLS exception were used.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The OTC/Nabeul custodian chain is credible, but current anonymous parcel-service availability and Hammamet coverage remain unresolved.
